cases.judgeRationale: The packet contains no returned candidates for this case. An empty result set is not independent evidence that compatible, original spark plugs are unavailable, so availability cannot be determined.

Neither listing independently verifies all four requirements for a Riyadh 12V 70Ah car battery: the first gives voltage and capacity but no specific Riyadh location; the second names Riyadh but omits voltage and capacity. The packet does not establish that qualifying stock is absent.

hardConstraints.evidence: The title says Car Battery and the description identifies it as a car battery.
The description says available across KSA cities but does not specifically verify availability in Riyadh.

candidates.evidence: The title and description support a car battery with the requested voltage and capacity. Location is only stated broadly as KSA cities, leaving Riyadh unverified.

No voltage is stated in the displayed title, description, or metadata.

The title explicitly names Riyadh among the markets for the car-battery offers.

cases.judgeRationale: The packet includes shampoo listings. One source-backed shampoo-range description explicitly says it offers options for dry hair, satisfying the sole hard requirement of shampoo and supporting usefulness for the stated dry-hair preference.

hardConstraints.evidence: The title says Dry Hair Shampoo, and the description identifies it as dry shampoo.

candidates.evidence: The listing is explicitly for dry shampoo, which meets the shampoo product-type requirement. Its description focuses on reducing oil and buildup, so it does not independently establish suitability as a wash shampoo for dry hair; the title and description can be read in two ways.

hardConstraints.evidence: The title identifies a shampoo range, and the description explicitly says it is a shampoo range.

candidates.evidence: The description says the range includes options for every hair type, explicitly including dry hair. This supports the requested preference, although no individual shampoo SKU is identified.

hardConstraints.evidence: The title is Shampoo and the description explicitly describes a shampoo assortment.

candidates.evidence: The listing is for shampoo and mentions both shampoos addressing hair concerns and dry shampoos, but does not specifically confirm that a listed regular shampoo is suitable for dry hair.
